body.message:
Unfortunately, the manager is not available at the moment. As previously communicated, the rate was subject to an increase, and we have updated the booking accordingly once we received confirmation of the revised rate.

We completely understand your concern; however, we kindly ask for your understanding that the revised rate is based on the current market conditions and is beyond our control.

Additionally, could you please clarify the specific issue or discrepancy you are referring to regarding the rate calculation? This will allow us to review it and assist you accordingly.
